name: lamsa-iap-bridge
description: Bundles @revenuecat/purchases-capacitor into a single window.LamsaIAP global for Lamsa's otherwise unbundled static pages to call from inside the Capacitor iOS app. Built locally/in CI; the output is committed to ../js/capacitor-iap-bridge.js. This sub-project's package.json is intentionally never the Vercel project's root, so it's never auto-built by Vercel.
